project.name: AIPowerSalon
project.description: Multi-tenant nail-salon POS SaaS. NestJS + Postgres(Kysely) backend serving six React/Vite front-end surfaces in one monorepo. Tenant/branch scope is ALWAYS derived server-side from the session; frontends never send tenantId/branchId.
project.architecture: npm-workspaces monorepo: apps/* (1 backend + 6 web frontends + 2 empty kiosk scaffolds), packages/* (shared ui)
applications: apps/api (NestJS, Kysely, Postgres 16) — backend for all surfaces

commands.test_api_core_specs: cd apps/api && npm test  (runs scripts/run-core-specs.sh for the 43 Nest-free *-core.spec.ts)
commands.migrate: Kysely migrations live in apps/api/db/migrations (run via the api's migrate script)

verifiedState_2026_06_22.e2e_money_path: PASS — live-Postgres run drove the real canonical services check-in -> queue -> assign(override) -> serve -> markDone -> qualityCheck(approved) -> sendToCheckout -> payCash; $30 service charged $32.33 tax-inclusive, payment persisted, ticket paid; every business gate (skill match, quality approval, per-step permission, cash tender) enforced; baseline rolled back clean

architectureRules.tenantIsolation: Every tenant request: TenantAuthGuard authenticates -> tenantId/branchId derived from session (req.ctx), NEVER from the browser -> RolePermissionGuard checks granular pos.* permission -> repositories apply tenant (and branch) scoping in SQL.
architectureRules.money: Always integer cents. Never floating point.
architectureRules.payments: Fiserv (CardPointe/Bolt) + Clover ONLY. Stripe and Square are permanently removed and must not return.
architectureRules.noDuplication: Repair canonical files; never create V2/New/Final/Fixed/Copy/Backup variants. Confirmed: 0 duplicate-named files in repo.
architectureRules.realtime: useRealtime(channel, refetch) on live operational screens; backend realtime-core.ts maps each domain event to the screens that should refetch.
architectureRules.design: Cream/gold luxury system (page #F7EFE3, gold #A96F22, Playfair Display + Hanken Grotesque). Mac-fit fixed shell (1440x900 min, 1920x1080 @100%), sidebar/topbar identical across every screen.
architectureRules.workflowStateMachine: apps/api/src/common/pos-workflow-core.ts — the single shared ticket lifecycle: serving -> service_done -> ready_checkout -> paid (+ cancelled).

canonicalFiles.pos_routes: apps/pos-web/src/App.tsx (literal routes + data-driven allNavItems() -> gated FeaturePage for not-yet-built sub-pages)

knownIssues.issue: checkout recordPayment wraps its INSERT in .catch(()=>undefined) and the ticket is still marked paid even if the insert fails. Only triggers on invalid FK data (never in prod with a real user UUID), but the failure mode is silent missing revenue.
knownIssues.recommendation: Surface the insert failure, or do not flip the ticket to 'paid' when the payment row did not persist.
